tasks.spec: ROLE: proof-suite reconciliation worker, round 2 (stage-split node expectations). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no model calls. CONTEXT: After the round-12 architecture change, the pathway has TWO user-wait stages: n_goal_ask (pre-offer resting node: opening, misses, out-of-hours answers, detour answers before any offer) and n_goal_response (post-offer resting node), plus n_mixed_intent (the one-question clarify after a mixed reply). The reconciled suite still expects n_goal_response everywhere. The v108 ladder run at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workLadder108/gl-ladder-v108/ladder.txt shows 14 failures, ALL of them either 'ended on n_goal_ask expected n_goal_response' or 'ended on n_mixed_intent expected n_goal_response' (with visibly correct behavior in the said-lines), except 'named weekday' which is a date-convention mismatch. SOURCES (copy into CWD, then edit): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workSuiteRecon/gl-suite-reconcile/goalloop_scenarios.py and phase_run_goalloop.py (the round-1 reconciled suite - build on it). THE EDITS, exactly: (1) For every scenario whose conversation ends BEFORE any offer has been made (opening, pre-offer detours like insurance/order/cost questions, bare-number, affirms-never-asked, out-of-hours answers, dead-end-search denial, new-office-number, fishes-for-fields, premature-booked check, pre-booking detour): expected end node becomes n_goal_ask. (2) Scenarios that end while an offer stands keep n_goal_response. (3) 'picks a slot but also asks for a different one': expected end node n_mixed_intent, and keep/strengthen the existing requirement that the response asks a clarify question naming the offered slot or the alternative - it must still reject any silently-sent new offer. (4) 'named weekday': align the expected date to the deployed following-weekday convention - a bare weekday name resolves to the NEXT occurrence strictly after today (if today is Tuesday, 'tuesday' means today+7); recompute the expected window accordingly in the runner/scenario. (5) Nothing else changes: behavioral bans, copy assertions, scoped-response evaluation, scenario count 37, names, RESULT line format all stay identical. (6) RECON2-NOTES.md: per-scenario one-liner, and the exact ladder command. Do not run the ladder.
